Name: Sync Incidents
Author: Admin

Parameters.Description: The name of the environment from which to sync incidents.
Your unique directory ID in Azure, also known as your tenant ID.
The URL for the OAuth 2.0 endpoint where the job will request an authentication token.
The base URL for the Graph API. The job will append specific API calls to this root URL to retrieve data.
The unique ID of the application registered in Azure Active Directory that is granted permissions to access Microsoft Sentinel.
The confidential key for the application, used in conjunction with the Client ID to authenticate and authorize the job.
The number of hours to synchronize incidents prior to the current time. The default value is `24`.
If selected, the integration validates the SSL certificate when connecting to the Microsoft Sentinel server. Enabled by default.

Description: Deprecated. This job synchronizes Google SecOps Alerts and Microsoft Sentinel Incidents. It ensures that comments, status, and tags are kept in sync between the two systems. For the job to identify the correct information, the Google SecOps case must have the “Microsoft Sentinel Incident” tag. If the alert didn’t originate from “Microsoft Azure Sentinel Incident Connector v2”,  you will need to add an “Incident_ID” context value to the case for the job to be able to find the correct information.
